description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended selpercatinib for the treatment of RET fusion-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) that has been previously treated but not with a RET inhibitor in adults. Selpercatinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS
